title: ComfyUI H3 context M18 closeout matrix
description: Deterministic, content-free closeout record for the M18 contract chain. Metrics carry a baseline and a final, each read from an accepted checkpoint's own committed artifact, and a metric that did not move says so. Blast-radius rows measure whether the M18-02 identity domains stayed separate end to end: one mutation per domain against one shared synthetic world, and every probe that moved.

probes.description: The shipped fingerprint functions this matrix watches, sorted and unique by probe_id.

metrics.description: What the chain changed, sorted and unique by metric_id.

rows.description: One row per mutation, sorted and unique by mutation_id. Every identity domain is exercised by at least one row.

authority.description: The function or record that computes this identity, named rather than pathed so a probe follows its function if the module moves.

depends_on.description: Domains whose material may legitimately move this identity, beyond its own. A stale-render identity declares semantic here and is right to. A semantic probe may declare nothing: it is the only domain a runtime may consume as an execution, cache or receipt identity, so an execution identity computed over render, fixture or bundle material is wrong before any mutation is applied.

unit.description: What is being counted. "89 to 89" and "308056 to 72778" are not the same kind of statement and a reader should not have to infer which one they are looking at.

moved.description: False is a real and useful result: the chain's headline number, shipped schema files, moved by nothing.

Probes whose identity changed. Never empty: a mutation that moves nothing observes nothing, and a matrix of inert probes proves separation trivially. Every entry declares this row's domain among its inputs.

unmoved.description: Probes whose identity did not change. Recorded rather than omitted, because "did not move" is the claim the row exists to make.
